concept1:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE complete Instagram feed advertisement for Brazilian brand Tem Link Aqui, exact portrait 4:5 ratio. Reference supplied image ONLY for brand colors, direct offer and readability; do NOT copy its layout, headline, three stacked catalog rows or button design. NEW CONCEPT: "Your content is ready; give its link a place in the directory." Bold editorial typography, clean off-white #F3F6F4, navy #0A192F, turquoise #4AF9EB. Brand wordmark top "Tem Link Aqui" with small turquoise diamond. Headline, correct Brazilian Portuguese, verbatim: "Você cria.
Aqui você divulga." Main visual a premium tangible paper index-catalog metaphor: one oversized upright white directory entry with a turquoise paper-tab labelled "Seu link", a distinct chain-link icon and only two gray text placeholder strokes, entering a clean small navy catalog tray. This is a conceptual illustration, not fake app UI; no phone, no website mockup, no invented numbers or customers. A large turquoise ribbon prominently states "Publique grátis." Supporting text clearly readable: "Sites, perfis e comunidades em um catálogo por tema e rede." Closing CTA as strong editorial text not fake button: "Cadastre seu link." Footer "temlinkaqui.com/divulgar" and "Publicação sujeita à análise." Give a substantially fresh contemporary graphic composition with clear asymmetry and generous whitespace, fewer elements than original, all key text large. Flat light background, gentle realistic material shading only in central object, no gradients as decoration. No arrows promising growth, traffic, money, audience or instant approval; no sexual imagery. Do not mention ad results. One standalone finished ad, no collage or surrounding frame.
concept2:

Below band simple readable statement "No catálogo Tem Link Aqui." Closing CTA "Cadastre seu link." with a subtle hand-drawn turquoise underline, no fake button. Bottom URL "temlinkaqui.com/divulgar". No photos, no phone, no three stacked cards, no gradients, no decorative orbs, no invented users or metrics, no earnings or traffic guarantees, no instant publication promise, no sexual imagery. Finish professionally balanced with whitespace. One standalone finished ad image.
concept3: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Instagram feed post suitable for boosting for Brazilian brand Tem Link Aqui, portrait exact 4:5 ratio. New distinct visual concept "simple steps to submit a link", NOT the reference's stacked catalogue row layout. Reference image only sets brand palette and direct value clarity. Flat off-white #F3F6F4 background, navy #0A192F bold geometric sans similar Outfit, turquoise #4AF9EB. Brand name "Tem Link Aqui" at top with little turquoise diamond. Big headline exact "Divulgar começa aqui." Offer immediately beneath in a large turquoise highlight exact "Publique seu link grátis." Middle visual is a very clean horizontal three-stage infographic across canvas with large icons and thin connecting arrows, NOT a phone: 1 account-person with small envelope; 2 link chain; 3 checklist magnifying glass. DISTINCT icon meanings. Use turquoise circles for numbers 1,2,3. Under stage 1 exact label "Crie a conta e confirme o e-mail"; under stage 2 "Envie seu link"; under stage 3 "Aguarde a análise". Wrap these labels in 2-3 lines readable at mobile size, with ample column spacing. Generous light whitespace around the horizontal sequence so the layout feels new and organized. Lower supporting text exact "Para sites, perfis e comunidades." Then large navy typographic CTA exact "Comece seu cadastro." Bottom URL "temlinkaqui.com/divulgar". Footer "Publicação sujeita à análise. Destaque pago opcional." Add one understated thin navy horizontal divider, no ornamental blobs or backgrounds. Overall visually balanced elegant instructional poster with 60px edge margins, no overcrowding or tiny text. Absolutely accurate Portuguese. No claims of instant publication, guaranteed traffic, earning money, performance statistics, testimonial, hot imagery, or WhatsApp exclusivity. No photo, no fake app screenshot, no 3D smartphone. One finished independent image, no collage.
